site.title: Muntaha Rahman — Painter, Photographer
site.description: Muntaha Rahman (Moon) — painter and photographer working in oil and light. Originals and prints by inquiry.

about.title: About
paragraphs: I'm a painter and photographer raised in New York by parents who came from Bangladesh. We lived with very little — many of us under one roof — and for a long time, privacy felt like a luxury. My parents worked incredibly hard so that I could eventually have a room of my own, a space to sit with my emotions, explore my creativity, and discover who I was without interruption.

That same impulse runs through my work. I paint the objects, rooms, and people that hold the lives my parents set aside so I could live mine. I am a painter today because they gave me the opportunity to become one.
